sloka: स तत्तदा वानरसैन्यमेवं रामं च सङ्ख्ये सह लक्ष्मणेन।विषादयित्वा सहसा विवेश पुरीं दशग्रीवभुजाभिगुप्ताम् ।। ६.७३.६९ ।।
transliteration: sa tattadā vānarasainyamevaṁ rāmaṁ ca saṅkhye saha lakṣmaṇena।viṣādayitvā sahasā viveśa purīṁ daśagrīvabhujābhiguptām ।। 6.73.69 ।।

translations.english: "How can it be possible now to destroy that great Indrajith who is conferred with boons of invincibility by the creator Brahma, who is steadfast and is concealed in dreadful form with weapons uplifted?"
